description: Goalkeeper invariant enforcement: blocks direct Edit/Write to an active goal's contract.md, log.md, state.json, active.json/chain.json, the verdict transaction journal, and every receipt.json even after completion or archival; it also protects the live mission's mission.json/mission-log.md/mission-completed.md. These files are managed by gk so the audit trail, receipt integrity, and contract immutability are guarantees rather than requests. The user-authored mission.md charter is never blocked.
